chapter_name: Universal Franchise and India's Electoral System
learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the superpower of voting in a democracy and how India successfully conducts the largest democratic elections in the entire world!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🗳️ The Power of Universal Adult Franchise
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Universal Adult Franchise is a big term with a beautiful meaning: every single adult citizen (18 years and above) has the right to vote! It doesn't matter if you are rich or poor, or what your religion or gender is. Everyone gets exactly one vote.

Imagine organizing a massive test for hundreds of millions of people! That is what the Election Commission of India does. They are an independent team that makes sure elections are fair, free from cheating, and organized perfectly across the country.

When people vote, nobody else is allowed to see who they voted for. This is called a secret ballot! Today, we use Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) where voters just press a button next to their favorite candidate's symbol in total privacy.

In a democracy, the real bosses are the citizens! By voting, we hire leaders to run the country. If those leaders do a bad job, the citizens use their voting power in the next election to replace them.

fun_activity.title: ✅ Hold a Family Election!
fun_activity.instructions: Host a secret-ballot election at home to decide your Sunday evening activity (e.g., Movie vs. Board Games). Make little paper ballots, set up a private voting box, and count the votes fairly!

quick_recap: ⭐ Universal Adult Franchise means all citizens aged 18 and above have an equal right to vote.
⭐ The Election Commission of India is the independent body responsible for conducting fair elections.
⭐ Voting is completely secret so that nobody can force or threaten citizens to vote a certain way.
⭐ Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) have made voting faster, easier, and more environmentally friendly.
⭐ Voting is the ultimate superpower of the people in a true democracy.
